- Guards all attacks

for every attack performed
*For 3 turns from the character's entry turn*
- ATK & chance of performing a critical hit 30%{passiveImg:up_g} within the turn
for every attack performed
*Starting from the 4th turn from the character's entry turn*
- ATK & chance of performing a critical hit 15%{passiveImg:up_g} within the turn
for every attack performed
*When receiving a normal attack*
- Counters with tremendous power

cards.name: Super Saiyan 3 Goku
cards.leader_skill:
"Final Trump Card" or 
"Majin Buu Saga" Category 
Ki +3 and HP, ATK & DEF +220%
cards.passive_skill_description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Receives an additional Ki +3 per Ki Sphere obtained
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 25%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For 6 turns from the character's entry turn*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 35%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When there are 3 "Final Trump Card" Category allies,
3 "Majin Buu Saga" Category allies or 3 "Golden Fighters"
Category allies attacking in the same turn*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 15%{passiveImg:up_g} before attacking for
4 turns from the character's entry turn
- Can nullify attacks that are guaranteed to hit, making it possible
to evade these attacks, for 6 turns from the character's entry turn
*When receiving an attack with 18 or more Ki*
- DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When activating the Active Skill or when attacking with 24 Ki*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every attack performed*
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 300%)
*After performing 3 attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 25%{passiveImg:up_g}
*After performing 9 attacks in battle*
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 25%{passiveImg:up_g}
cards.active_skill_effect:
Causes ultimate damage to enemy and, 
within the turn activated, 
all attacks become critical hits; 
raises all allies' DEF by 39%, 
changes PHY Ki Spheres to Rainbow Ki Spheres 
and foresees enemy's Super Attack for 1 turn
cards.active_skill_condition:
Can be activated after the character 
evades 3 or more enemy attacks 
(including Super Attacks) in battle, 
after the character performs 
9 or more attacks in battle, 
or starting from the 5th turn from 
the character's entry turn (once only)
special_descriptions:
Greatly raises DEF and 
causes colossal damage to enemy

Massively raises ATK and 
causes mega-colossal damage to enemy

Massively raises ATK, 
further massively raises ATK for 1 turn and 
causes mega-colossal damage to enemy; 
raises allies' ATK & DEF by 39% for 1 turn 
(self excluded)

Massively raises ATK and 
causes mega-colossal damage to enemy; 
raises allies' ATK & DEF by 39% for 2 turns 
(self excluded)
causality_descriptions:
Activated when Ki is 18 or more with 
an ally whose name includes "Vegeta" 
(Kid, Jr., King, Baby, Duplicate, etc. excluded) 
attacking in the same turn

Activated when Ki is 18 or more with 
an ally whose name includes "Hercule" 
or "Buu" attacking in the same turn

cards.name: Majin Buu (South Supreme Kai)
cards.leader_skill:
"Majin Buu Saga" Category 
Ki +3, HP +170% and ATK & DEF +140%, 
plus an additional HP, ATK & DEF +30% 
for characters who are also Extreme Class
cards.passive_skill_description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +3 and ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Recovers 15% HP
- Extreme Class allies' ATK & DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus an additional
chance of performing a critical hit 10%{passiveImg:up_g} for characters who
also belong to the "Majin Power" Category
*Per "Sworn Enemies" or "Majin Buu Saga" Category ally on the team
(depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 500%)
*When there is another "Sworn Enemies" or "Majin Buu Saga"
Category ally attacking in the same turn*
- ATK & DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Damage reduction rate 55%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking for the 1st time*
- The more HP remaining, the greater the ATK boost within the turn
(up to 1000%{passiveImg:up_g})
*If HP is 60% or more when attacking*
- Chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
special_descriptions:
Greatly raises ATK & DEF for 1 turn with 
a great chance of further raising ATK, 
causes supreme damage to enemy 
and recovers 5% HP
cards.link_skill_description_3: ATK +20% when HP is 50% or below
cards.link_skill_description_10_3: ATK +30% when HP is 50% or less
cards.link_skill_description_4: ATK & DEF +25% when HP is 80% or below

cards.passive_skill_name: The Greatest and Most Fearsome Rival
cards.passive_skill_description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}Damage reduction rate 20%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking and
Ki +5 for 4 turns
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}Damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 350%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Survives K.O. attacks (up to once within a turn)
- Recovers 20% HP
*When activating the Active Skill or when attacking with 18 or more Ki*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*Starting from the 5th turn from the character's entry turn,
or if HP is 20% or less when attacking*
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Performs a critical hit
*For every attack received or evaded*
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +5 (up to +15)
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 300%)
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 60%)
*When there are 3 "Majin Power" Category allies, 3 "Majin Buu Saga"
Category allies or 3 "Sworn Enemies" Category allies attacking in the
same turn*
- {passiveImg:once}Evades enemy's attack if HP is 1% or less when receiving
an attack
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 90%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 1% or less
when receiving an attack for 4 turns from the character's entry turn
and chance of evading enemy's attack 80%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 1% or less
when receiving an attack starting from the 5th turn from the
character's entry turn
- Damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} if HP is 1% or less when attacking
*When all allies are "Sworn Enemies" Category characters*
- All allies' chance of performing a critical hit 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*At the end of turn*
- Recovers 30% HP
